errors.meaning: The file could not be read or written.
The text is not valid JSON (or not valid UTF-8).
Not an OHAO scene: "format" is missing or not "ohao.scene", or "version" or "entities" is missing.
The document version is not one this engine reads.
A component's version in the file is newer than the engine's, or older with no upgrade path.
An upgrade (migration) rejected a component written by an older version.
A member the type does not have, or a runtime-only component in a file.
The same member appears twice in one object.
A value of the wrong JSON type or shape.
A string that is not a value of the enum.
A number outside the field's limits or its type's range.
NaN or infinity, which a scene cannot contain.
A missing, malformed or zero entity id (ids are 16 lowercase hex digits).
Two entities with the same id.
A Parent that names no entity in the document.
Parents that form a cycle.
A second instance of a component that allows one per world.
An entity reference that names no entity in the document.
Loading into a world that already has entities.
More errors exist than are reported (the first 100 are).
An unknown API method.
A request that is malformed or cannot apply (unknown op, missing member, absent component).
A request names a type that is not a component (or, for edits, not a saved one).
A path that reaches no field: "/Type/field", then optionally member names or array indices.
No snapshot has this name (world.restore).
An asset path that names no file in the project (or leaves the project).
An asset file that exists but cannot be loaded (format or content).
A MeshSource that gives no usable geometry (InstantiateError).
render.capture failed: no usable GPU, a frame that failed, or an image that could not be written.
An internal error in a tool (a bug); the operation did not complete (ohao exits with 3).
A path outside the server's sandbox: absolute, with '..', or a write outside the output directory.
A method not allowed in the current time mode or host.
An input recording that does not match the world it is replayed on.
A level node whose transform is not translation, rotation and scale (shear or perspective).
A level file that needs an extension OHAO does not read (Draco or meshopt compression).
A level node's extras with a bad hint value or an unknown capitalised key (a misspelt component); the node loads without it.
Warning: an unknown component close to a known name. It is kept, but may be a typo.
Warning: an entity renders a mesh with no MeshSource (made in code); it is saved without it.
Warning: an unknown lower-case key in a level node's extras (another tool's property); ignored.
Warning: level content OHAO ignores (skins, animations, morph targets, KHR_materials_*, orthographic cameras).
Warning: a dynamic body's mesh collider; it is built as the mesh's convex hull, since triangle meshes do not simulate.
Warning: a collider with no size on an entity whose mesh is missing or did not load; it gets no collider.
Warning: a sphere or capsule collider under a scale whose axes differ by more than 1%; it takes the largest axis.
What a method was asked about is not there: no level in the world, or an entity that is not a level (level.info, level.reload).
Params that pass their schema but break a rule of the method: physics.raycast's zero direction, or max outside (0, 100000].
Warning: a level without a "player" spawn (level.info). Not an error: a prop kit has none.
Warning: a dynamic body under a parent scaled unevenly; the pose physics writes back to its Transform is approximate (physics.info).
Warning: a PlayerController in a world with no SpawnPoint tagged "player"; it starts where its entity is (physics.info).
Warning: the physics backend could not make a player's character; it does not move (physics.info).

enums.name: LightType
enums.doc: Light shape. Position and direction come from the entity's world transform; the direction is the entity's -Z axis.

values.name: Point
values.doc: Omnidirectional point light at the entity's position

values.name: Directional
values.doc: Infinitely distant light (a sun) shining along -Z

values.name: Spot
values.doc: Cone of light along -Z, shaped by innerConeDeg/outerConeDeg

values.name: AreaRect
values.doc: Rectangle spanned by areaEdge1 and areaEdge2, emitting along -Z

enums.name: Key
enums.doc: A keyboard key or mouse button an action or axis is bound to

values.name: None
values.doc: Nothing (an unbound side of an axis)

enums.name: ColliderShape
enums.doc: A collider's shape, fitted to the entity's mesh unless a size is given.

values.name: Sphere
values.doc: Around the bounding box's centre, to the farthest vertex

values.name: Capsule
values.doc: Along the bounding box's longest axis

values.name: Convex
values.doc: The convex hull of the mesh's vertices

values.name: Mesh
values.doc: The mesh's triangles (static and kinematic bodies; a dynamic one is made convex)

values.name: Dynamic
values.doc: Moved by the simulation; writes its entity's Transform each step

values.name: Kinematic
values.doc: Moved by its transform; dynamic bodies collide with it

values.name: Chase
values.doc: Walking to where it last saw the player

values.name: Attack
values.doc: Stopped, turned to the player, firing bursts

types.name: Name
types.doc: Display name for people and agents. Not unique; entities are identified by id.

types.name: Transform
types.doc: Local transform relative to the parent (or the world for a root entity). World matrix = parent world * T * R * S.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Local rotation as a unit quaternion, written [x, y, z, w]

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Local scale per axis; a negative value mirrors

types.name: Parent
types.doc: Attaches the entity to a parent; its Transform is then relative to the parent. Cycles are rejected.

fields.name: entity
fields.doc: The parent entity's id; null makes the entity a root

types.name: Light
types.doc: A light source. Position and direction come from the transform (direction = -Z).

fields.name: range
fields.doc: Distance at which a Point/Spot light's contribution reaches zero

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Emitter radius; larger values give softer shadows

fields.name: outerConeDeg
fields.doc: Spot: cone angle where intensity reaches zero

fields.name: areaEdge1
fields.doc: AreaRect: first edge vector, local space

fields.name: areaEdge2
fields.doc: AreaRect: second edge vector, local space

fields.name: castShadows
fields.doc: Whether geometry blocks this light in the raster frame: RT shadows (one shadow-mask channel each, for the first 4 lights that cast them), or the cascaded shadow map for a directional light when RT shadows are off. False lights through everything. The path tracer always traces visibility

types.name: ModelAsset
types.doc: A model file (glb, gltf, fbx, obj, dae, blend, 3ds, ply) loaded through the asset resolver; its own materials are used.

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: Project-relative path of the model file, '/' separators

fields.name: mesh
fields.doc: One mesh of a glTF file, by name or '#<index>', at its own origin with only its own materials; empty: the whole file, every node's meshes merged in place

types.name: SpherePrim
types.doc: A UV sphere around the origin.

types.name: CubePrim
types.doc: A cube around the origin.

types.name: PlatformPrim
types.doc: A flat box (a floor slab or platform) around the origin.

types.name: CylinderPrim
types.doc: A capped cylinder along Y, centered on the origin.

types.name: ConePrim
types.doc: A capped cone along Y, centered on the origin.

types.name: QuadPrim
types.doc: One quad a-b-c-d (triangles a-b-c, a-c-d) with a flat normal and a vertex color.

types.name: BoxPrim
types.doc: An axis-aligned box from lo to hi: 6 faces with flat normals and a vertex color.

types.name: MeshSource
types.doc: Where the entity's mesh comes from: a model asset or a primitive. Instantiate builds the GPU mesh; entities with equal sources share one mesh.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Exactly one of the alternatives, as {"Name": {...}}

types.name: MaterialOverride
types.doc: The material of a mesh without its own materials (primitives). For a model with materials it only sets the legacy RT GI albedo.

fields.name: subsurface
fields.doc: Subsurface scattering (skin, wax): how much of the lit colour the screen-space blur spreads under the surface; 0 = none. Ignored where emissiveStrength > 0.

types.name: Camera
types.doc: The scene camera (one per world). Its pose is the entity's world transform: it looks along -Z with +Y up; roll is ignored.

fields.name: farPlane
fields.doc: Far clip distance (raster passes); keep it above nearPlane

fields.name: active
fields.doc: false: the host keeps its own camera

types.name: Environment
types.doc: Image-based lighting (one per world): an equirectangular HDR image lighting and backing the scene.

fields.name: hdri
fields.doc: Project-relative path of the .hdr image; null for none

types.name: Spin
types.doc: Turns the entity about an axis of its own frame at a constant rate (the spin system, which runs before the transform system on every world update).

fields.name: axis
fields.doc: Rotation axis in the entity's local frame; any length (normalized), zero for no rotation

fields.name: degreesPerSecond
fields.doc: Turn rate; negative turns the other way

types.name: ActionBinding
types.doc: An action name bound to a key: held while the key is down.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: The action's name, as systems and input.inject use it

types.name: AxisBinding
types.doc: An axis name bound to two keys: +1 while positive is down, -1 while negative is, 0 for both or neither.

fields.name: axis
fields.doc: The axis's name, as systems and input.inject use it

types.name: InputActions
types.doc: The world's controls (one per world): action and axis names over keys. The world's input map is rebuilt from it whenever it is set, changed or removed.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc: Action bindings; an action with several keys is held while any is

types.name: FlyController
types.doc: Flies the entity from named axes and actions, once per fixed step: forward along its -Z, right along its +X, up along world +Y; while `look` is held the mouse turns it (yaw about world +Y, pitch about its +X). On the Camera entity it is a fly camera.

fields.name: moveSpeed
fields.doc: Speed at an axis value of 1

fields.name: lookDegPerUnit
fields.doc: Turn per unit of mouse movement while `look` is held

fields.name: look
fields.doc: Action that, while held, lets the mouse turn the entity

fields.name: fast
fields.doc: Action that, while held, multiplies the speed

types.name: PlayerController
types.doc: A first-person player: a capsule standing on the entity's position (its feet), turned about +Y. Once per fixed step, before bodies step, it walks from the named axes and actions (forward along its -Z, right along its +X), jumps, climbs steps and slopes, and pushes dynamic bodies. It spawns at the first SpawnPoint tagged "player"; triggers and rays see it.

fields.name: eyeHeight
fields.doc: The eyes above the feet (the first-person camera)

fields.name: walkSpeed
fields.doc: Speed at a move axis of 1

fields.name: acceleration
fields.doc: How fast the horizontal velocity reaches the wanted one

fields.name: airControl
fields.doc: Fraction of the acceleration while in the air

fields.name: jumpSpeed
fields.doc: Upward speed of a jump (4.9 m/s: 1.22 m high)

fields.name: maxSlopeDeg
fields.doc: Steepest walkable ground; steeper is a wall

fields.name: mass
fields.doc: Mass pressing on what it stands on

fields.name: pushForce
fields.doc: The most force it pushes a dynamic body with

fields.name: lookDegPerUnit
fields.doc: Turn per unit of mouse movement, or of a look axis's value in a step

fields.name: jump
fields.doc: Action that jumps when pressed on the ground

fields.name: sprint
fields.doc: Action that, while held, walks at sprintSpeed

fields.name: lookX
fields.doc: Axis turning the player (yaw), added to the mouse's x

fields.name: lookY
fields.doc: Axis tilting the view (pitch), added to the mouse's y

fields.name: spawn
fields.doc: The SpawnPoint tag it spawns at: the k-th character with a tag (creation order) takes the k-th spawn point with it; empty: it starts where it stands

fields.name: input
fields.doc: Moved by the world's input (a player); false: by its MoveIntent (an AI or an agent)

types.name: MoveIntent
types.doc: The move a character without input (PlayerController.input false) makes each step, written by the enemy AI or an agent. Absent: it stands still, facing as it faces.

fields.name: move
fields.doc: x right, y forward, in its own frame; each within -1..1

fields.name: yawDeg
fields.doc: The facing to take, about +Y from -Z

types.name: Level
types.doc: A level file (glTF) placed in the world. The level system expands it into one child entity per node of the file's default scene (LevelNode), with ids hashed from this entity's id and the node's index; those entities are the file's and are never saved. Node extras give hints (col, body, mass, fric, rest, vis, spawn, socket) and components by name.

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: Project-relative path of the .glb or .gltf file, '/' separators

fields.name: lightScale
fields.doc: Multiplier on the file's KHR_lights_punctual intensities

fields.name: collision
fields.doc: Whether the level's nodes get colliders; false: render only

types.name: SpawnPoint
types.doc: A named place to spawn something, at the entity's world position, facing its -Z. Spawns are taken in creation order (a level's node order).

types.name: Socket
types.doc: An attach point at the entity's transform (a level's SOCKET_ empties).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The socket's name, as attachments refer to it

types.name: Collider
types.doc: The entity collides: the physics system builds a body for it (static unless it has a RigidBody). A zero size fits the shape to the entity's mesh, in its frame and at its world scale.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Zero: fit to the mesh. Box: half extents; Sphere: x is the radius; Capsule: x the radius, y the half height of its straight part

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: The shape's centre in the entity's frame, with an explicit size

fields.name: trigger
fields.doc: A trigger volume: reports bodies entering and leaving it (trigger_enter, trigger_exit) and blocks nothing

fields.name: surface
fields.doc: What it is made of, for footsteps on it (concrete, metal, wood, ...); empty is "default"

types.name: RigidBody
types.doc: How the entity's body moves. Dynamic bodies are simulated at the world's fixed step and move their entity; static and kinematic ones follow it.

types.name: Health
types.doc: Hit points. Damage (a weapon's round, combat.damage) takes current down to 0, which is dead: the dead take no more damage and do not fire.

types.name: Weapon
types.doc: A hitscan weapon, fired once per fixed step at most, after physics. A player fires it from its eye along its look by the world's input (`fire`, `reload`); anything else from its origin along its -Z by its WeaponTrigger. Each round is one ray within the spread cone; what it hits takes `damage` if it or an ancestor has Health. Recoil turns a player's view.

fields.name: automatic
fields.doc: Fires while `fire` is held; false: one round a press

fields.name: magazine
fields.doc: Rounds a magazine (the reserve is unlimited)

fields.name: spreadDeg
fields.doc: Half angle of the spread cone at rest

fields.name: bloomPerShotDeg
fields.doc: Added to the cone by each round

fields.name: bloomMaxDeg
fields.doc: The most bloom adds to the cone

fields.name: bloomRecoveryDegPerSec
fields.doc: How fast bloom falls once the fire interval passes without a round

fields.name: recoilYawDeg
fields.doc: View kick sideways a round, at most, either way (seeded)

fields.name: recoilRecoveryDegPerSec
fields.doc: How fast the vertical kick comes back down once the fire interval passes without a round

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Seed of the spread's and recoil's random numbers

types.name: WeaponState
types.doc: What a weapon has and is doing. Written by the combat step, which adds it (a full magazine) to a Weapon without one.

fields.name: cooldown
fields.doc: Time until the next round may fire

fields.name: bloomDeg
fields.doc: Added to the spread cone now

fields.name: kickDeg
fields.doc: Vertical view kick not yet recovered

fields.name: shots
fields.doc: Rounds fired: the index of the next round's random numbers

fields.name: triggerHeld
fields.doc: The trigger at the last step (one round a press)

fields.name: flash
fields.doc: Muzzle flash left (the Muzzle's light is on while above 0)

types.name: Muzzle
types.doc: A weapon's muzzle flash, on a Light below the weapon's entity: the combat step turns the light to `intensity` for `time` after each round and to 0 otherwise (a light at 0 has no emitter mesh, so the flash is the light's mesh while it is on).

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: The Light's intensity while the flash is on

fields.name: time
fields.doc: How long the flash stays on after a round

types.name: ViewModel
types.doc: A first-person gun, on its root below the camera's entity: its subtree is drawn remapped in view space (toward the eye by depthScale, as if through a fovDeg lens, so it never reaches a wall) and moved at render rate by sway, bob and kick. Presentation only: the motion is never saved or hashed, and lockstep and headless frames draw the rest pose.

fields.name: fovDeg
fields.doc: The lens the gun is drawn through

fields.name: depthScale
fields.doc: Shrink toward the eye in view space

fields.name: swayDegPerDeg
fields.doc: Lag per degree the view turns

fields.name: swayReturnPerSec
fields.doc: How fast the sway returns (exponential rate)

fields.name: kickReturnPerSec
fields.doc: How fast the kick returns (exponential rate)

types.name: WeaponTrigger
types.doc: The trigger of a weapon that is not a player's: an AI, a turret or an agent pulls it.

fields.name: reload
fields.doc: Reload now; cleared when acted on

types.name: Enemy
types.doc: An enemy: a character (PlayerController with input false) with Health and a Weapon, driven by the enemy AI at the start of each combat step: idle until it sees the player or is hit, then it chases the place it last saw the player, and in range with a clear line it attacks in bursts.

fields.name: fovDeg
fields.doc: The cone it notices the player in while idle

fields.name: attackRange
fields.doc: How near it comes before it stops and fires

fields.name: reactionTime
fields.doc: From first sight to first round

fields.name: aimErrorDeg
fields.doc: At most this off the player, each round (seeded)

fields.name: loseTime
fields.doc: How long it chases without seeing the player

types.name: EnemyState
types.doc: What an enemy is doing. The enemy AI writes it, and adds it to an Enemy without one.

fields.name: lastSeen
fields.doc: Where it last saw the player (its feet)

fields.name: lostFor
fields.doc: Since it last saw the player

fields.name: pause
fields.doc: Left of the pause between bursts

fields.name: lastHealth
fields.doc: Its health at the last step (a fall wakes it); < 0: unknown

fields.name: shotsSeen
fields.doc: Its weapon's shots at the last step (counts a burst)

types.name: Round
types.doc: The round's rules (one per world). The world's state at the end of its first combat step is the round's start; restartDelay after the player dies, or when `restart` is pressed, the world goes back to it. Every Enemy dead wins the round (it then waits for `restart`).

fields.name: restartDelay
fields.doc: From the player's death to the restart

fields.name: restart
fields.doc: Action that restarts the round now

types.name: SkinnedMesh
types.doc: A skinned mesh: the entity's MeshSource (a ModelAsset with `mesh`) is deformed by a skin of a glTF file, posed by the entity's Animator. The instance gets its own deformed copy of the mesh.

fields.name: skin
fields.doc: The skin's name or "#<index>"; empty: the file's first skin

types.name: AnimLayerState
types.doc: One layer of an Animator: its state, the steps in it, and the fade from the state it left.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: The layer's current state (empty: its initial state)

fields.name: from
fields.doc: The state faded from; empty when not fading

fields.name: fade
fields.doc: The fade's length in steps (0: none)

types.name: Animator
types.doc: Poses an entity by an animation graph (.animgraph.json): each layer's state machine advances one step a simulation step (integers only, so a snapshot holds it exactly). The pose is presentation: never saved or hashed.

fields.name: layers
fields.doc: One a graph layer, in order; empty: filled at the first step

types.name: JointAttach
types.doc: Drawn at a joint of its parent's pose (times its own Transform): a rifle in a hand. Presentation: its Transform, and what the step sees, do not follow the joint.

fields.name: joint
fields.doc: The joint's name in the parent's skeleton

types.name: MeshHandle
types.doc: A mesh slot in the GPU render scene. Runtime only: files refer to meshes by source.

fields.name: generation
fields.doc: Slot generation; a stale handle no longer matches

types.name: MaterialHandle
types.doc: A material slot in the GPU render scene. Runtime only.

types.name: Children
types.doc: The entity's children in attach order. Derived: rebuilt from Parent.

types.name: WorldTransform
types.doc: World matrices computed by the transform system from Transform and Parent.

types.name: MeshRenderer
types.doc: The GPU mesh and materials an entity renders with. Built from the entity's mesh source.

fields.name: materials
fields.doc: One material per submesh, in submesh order

types.name: RenderSlot
types.doc: The entity's instance slot in the GPU render scene. Owned by the render extract.

types.name: EmissiveProxyLight
types.doc: A point light approximating a mesh's emissive texture. Derived from the model.

fields.name: localCenter
fields.doc: Center in the entity's model space

types.name: GiMaterialLegacy
types.doc: LEGACY: the RT GI per-instance material word (albedo rgb, packed roughness/metallic in a).

fields.name: packed
fields.doc: rgb = albedo, a = packed roughness/metallic/vertex-count rule

types.name: CreationOrder
types.doc: Monotonic creation sequence. Orders draws, lights and file entities deterministically.

types.name: PreservedComponent
types.doc: One unknown component kept from a scene file.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Component name as written in the file

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Its version from the file header (1 if absent)

fields.name: json
fields.doc: Its value as canonical compact JSON

types.name: PreservedComponents
types.doc: Components a scene file carried that this build does not know; written back on save.

fields.name: entries
fields.doc: The kept components, in file order

types.name: TransformDirty
types.doc: Tag: the local transform changed; world matrices are recomputed this frame.

types.name: RenderDirty
types.doc: Tag: the entity's render instance is re-uploaded this frame.

types.name: MovedLastFrame
types.doc: Tag: moved last frame; uploaded once more so prevWorld catches up.

types.name: InstantiateDirty
types.doc: Tag: MeshSource or MaterialOverride changed; instantiate rebuilds the mesh renderer this frame.

types.name: InstantiateError
types.doc: Why instantiate could not build the entity's mesh. The entity then has no MeshRenderer.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: What went wrong, for people and agents

types.name: LevelNode
types.doc: This entity is a node of a level: made by the level system from the file, never saved, rebuilt from the file when its Level changes.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: The node's index in the default scene, depth first

types.name: LevelDirty
types.doc: Tag: the Level changed; the level system re-expands it this frame.

types.name: ColliderPart
types.doc: This entity's collider is part of another entity's body (a level's UCX_ hulls): one compound body.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The entity whose body it is part of

types.name: CollisionMesh
types.doc: The mesh a level node's collider is fitted to when the node is not drawn (vis 0, UCX_ hulls) and so has no MeshSource. Set by the level system.

types.name: PhysicsBody
types.doc: The entity's body in the physics backend. Owned by the physics system.

types.name: PhysicsMoved
types.doc: Tag: an entity with a body moved; the physics system moves the body this frame.

types.name: PlayerState
types.doc: The player as the physics system left it after the last step. Owned by the physics system.

fields.name: yawDeg
fields.doc: Facing about +Y from -Z, counter-clockwise seen from above

fields.name: pitchDeg
fields.doc: Looking up (positive) or down, within 89 degrees

types.name: BodyMotion
types.doc: The motion a dynamic body or a player carries into the next step. Written by the physics system; never saved or hashed, but held by snapshots (a restore whose bodies were rebuilt since puts it back).

fields.name: asleep
fields.doc: The body sleeps; its velocities are zero
